text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio! Today's the day you finally admit
defeat!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're even louder than normal.
All right,
I'll bite. What's got you excited
enough to bother
me?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Listen close! Yesterday during the rain, I
trained
on the track when it was super
muddy!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: And you won't believe who came up to me! She said, "Running on a muddy track... You're no cur-mud-geon."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's that mean? Sounds like
some kinda
pun...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... That's right! Your
precious prez
gave me a compliment!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then she was all like, "I can't let the mud
muddle
my senses either" or something,
like... she was
challenging me? And we
even ran together!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: That's how great she thought my running was!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You went partner running with her?!
Errrgh! I
could brush this off if it was just
the pun, but
now...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Watch out! I'm gonna come up with an
amazing
plan to beat you in no time at
all!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gahaha! I'll be ready for ya!
